proposal.title: Ilonaevak: a validator for mail authentication records
proposal.summary: Ilonaevak builds a validator for mail authentication records for administrators of self-hosted mail.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Mail servers reject legitimate mail because authentication records are hard to get right. Administrators of self-hosted mail depend on email authentication every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We will build a validator for mail authentication records called Ilonaevak. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: Email authentication is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/ilonaevak/ilonaevak, which 235 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on email authentication for 5 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the GPL-3.0-or-later licence in http://forge.test/ilonaevak/ilonaevak. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 10 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 5. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8. Documentation and release ends in month 10.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 74550.00 EUR for 117 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 500.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Problem
Mail servers reject legitimate mail because authentication records are hard to get right. Administrators of self-hosted mail depend on email authentication every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

Approach
We will build a validator for mail authentication records called Ilonaevak. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
Email authentication is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

Team and experience
We maintain http://forge.test/ilonaevak/ilonaevak, which 235 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on email authentication for 5 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under the GPL-3.0-or-later licence in http://forge.test/ilonaevak/ilonaevak. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 10 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 5. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8. Documentation and release ends in month 10.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 74550.00 EUR for 117 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 500.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.
